# Shared shell/Rust parity fixture for the `android_auto` opt-in lever (owner decision D1, 2026-10-19).
#
# Format: <expected>|<document>
#   expected 1 = Android Auto REQUESTED (explicit true, no explicit false); 0 = not requested.
#   document: `\n` separates lines; `\t` `\v` `\f` `\r` are tab / vertical tab / form feed / CR
#   (decoded by printf '%b' in tools/run_tests.sh and by the Rust test
#   `box_common::cfg::tests::aa_lever_matches_the_shared_shell_fixture`).
# Both sides assert this column, so a drift in EITHER matcher fails the suite. Do not put `|` in a document.
